summary: A son of Andrew Pringle born about 1863, recorded as a boy in his father's household; John's 3rd-great-grand-uncle.
bio: Samuel Pringle was born about 1862 or 1863, a son of Andrew Pringle, and was John's 3rd-great-grand-uncle. He appears as a child in his father's household in 1870 and again in 1880, when he was seventeen.

Samuel, 17 in 1880 (FamilySearch c.1862).

FamilySearch has Samuel only in Andrew's 1870 and 1880 households (born 1862-63) ([R4-S1]). No later record was found, and Bradsby's 1893 list of Andrew's living children should be checked for his name.
